key_insight: Constraining each orbital’s effective potential to depend on the density excluding that orbital removes self-interaction and satisfies the generalized Koopmans condition.
engineering_relevance: The approach could improve DFT-based band-gap predictions for semiconductor and electronic-materials screening.
method: Formulate KS equations with orbital-density-dependent constraints.
Use an effective potential based on the total density minus the orbital’s own density.
Enforce energy linearity with orbital-density variation.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports an approximately 1 eV reduction in fundamental band-gap mean absolute errors for LDA and GGA relative to standard KS-DFT.
watch_item: The abstract does not specify benchmark materials, computational overhead, or implementation details needed to assess practical scalability.
paper_title: Exact subtraction of electron self-interaction from the Kohn-Sham equations
